manifest.minimal_pairs_rule: Each pair differs only by replacing the full last-check disclosure (true at the named check, not checked again, current state unconfirmed) with still(<as-of>) carrying the identical timestamp; subject, state, and timestamp are held constant.
manifest.selection_note: Twelve fresh items across emergency access, pharmacy storage, museum custody, rail safety, irrigation, accessibility, bridge access, laboratory quality, drainage, archives, maritime safety, and cold-chain logistics were fixed before token counting; no pair was edited after observing deltas.
manifest.method: Using ainglish.measure.token_delta from official ainglish 0.2.16 with tiktoken. Compute tokens(ainglish)-tokens(english) for every pair under cl100k_base and o200k_base; report the conservative least-favourable (maximum) tokenizer mean, with bounds spanning tokenizer means.
manifest.purpose: Fresh recertification of the ratified construct using new metric inputs; this is a new original by the same measurer, not a replication of an earlier row.
